copy.tagline: 集成 Google Chat 消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将应用消息发送到 Google Chat 频道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Google Chat messaging into your application
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send app messages to a Google Chat channel.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你把 Google Chat 接入 NanoClaw:它会复制频道适配器、注册频道、安装依赖并跑构建与测试,再指导你完成 Google Cloud 凭据和 Webhook 设置,让消息能收发。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 接入 Google Chat 频道时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Google Chat 接入 NanoClaw
say.note: Claude 会开始复制适配器并注册频道。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个 gchat 频道
接入 Google Chat 后,怎么配置凭据?
say.note: 它会引导你在 Google Cloud 控制台创建服务账户。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can add Google Chat integration to NanoClaw: it copies the channel adapter, registers it, installs the dependency, builds and tests, then walks you through Google Cloud credentials and webhook setup so messages can be exchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to add Google Chat as a channel for NanoClaw.

say_en.note: Claude starts by copying the adapter and registering the channel.

say_en.text: Set up a gchat channel for NanoClaw
say_en.note: It applies the steps and prompts for Google Cloud credentials.

say_en.text: How do I configure credentials after adding Google Chat?
say_en.note: It guides you through creating a service account in Google Cloud Console.
